confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live menus, tariffs or listings. Food and dorm anchors are the most reliable; the 3-star hotel is least certain, and July is peak surf season, so accommodation may run above typical levels. Cocktail and wine were scaled from the beer anchor (about 1.7x and 2x) because direct local price knowledge is weak. The FX figure came from a web search summary of the RBA Exchange Rates page, not a direct page read, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. The basis is general Sri Lankan east- and south-coast surf and beach-tourism price levels, adjusted for peak July demand in Arugam Bay.
